title: No cart check at all
story: ShopBot skips the cart check and goes straight to asking whether it may pay INR 3,000 at FreshMart. From INR 2,000 a cart check is required, so the Guard asks Asha instead.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Pick up some snacks and drinks for the weekend.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Snacks and drinks at FreshMart come to INR 3,000. Asking AgentPay Guard if I may pay.

what_to_notice: Skipping the check never gets a quicker yes: no check counts the same as an unsure one. No model was called, so this run cost nothing.
